{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A silk-blend midi sheath dress, A-line silhouette that skims the hips without clinging, color #dcb995 (soft champagne), fluid drape fabric with a subtle lustrous finish.
Silver statement cufflinks and drop earrings, polished geometric shapes that catch the light under artificial evening lighting, metal and crystal details.
Pointy-toe pumps, medium height heel for elongation while remaining stable on grass, color #1b1815 (deep black), smooth leather upper.

This outfit works because the champagne hue provides a warm contrast to her dark hair and skin, immediately making her stand out as requested without looking flashy against typical white wedding colors. The A-line midi length and fluid silk fabric ensure comfort for an hour-long outdoor ceremony in August while maintaining a refined, smart-soiree silhouette appropriate for transitioning to dinner. Strategic silver jewelry acts as a focal point that aligns with her desire to be memorable, leveraging artificial lighting at the restaurant to create a lasting visual impression."}
